assets.voice_description: Warm, clear Indian English voice, gender-neutral leaning female, early thirties, educated pan-Indian accent that is easy for global listeners to follow. Close to the microphone, calm and attentive, unhurried, a gentle smile in the voice, precise diction, quietly reassuring and capable. Not a call-centre or newsreader tone.
assets.text: I read the contract Priya sent. Three things changed, and I've marked each one so you can see exactly where. I've drafted a reply as well, but nothing goes out until you say so. Ready when you are.

assets.voice_description: Warm, slightly low Indian English female voice in her thirties, urban pan-Indian accent clear to global listeners, perceptive and quietly confident with a hint of playful wit. Smooth relaxed pacing, like a trusted friend who is always one step ahead.
assets.text: You mentioned the Pune trip twice this week, so I looked into it. The Thursday morning train is cheaper and gets you there before lunch. I've kept both options side by side, in case you'd rather sleep in.

assets.voice_description: Deep, soft, kind Indian English male voice in his sixties, gentle pan-Indian accent clear to global listeners, slow unhurried pacing with natural pauses, grounded and patient like a beloved grandfather who gardens every morning.
assets.text: There's no hurry. Let's take this one step at a time. First we'll gather what you already have, then we'll see what's missing. Good things grow slowly, beta, and so do good plans.

assets.voice_description: Friendly, bright Indian English voice of a young woman in her twenties, modern pan-Indian accent clear to global listeners, curious and practical, upbeat but grounded, slightly bubbly rhythm, an encouraging teammate who loves solving puzzles.
assets.text: Ooh, this is a good puzzle. Okay, here's what I found: the numbers don't add up in March, and I think I know why. Should I fix it, or shall we look at it together first? Either way, you've got this.

assets.voice_description: Bright, quick, cheerful Indian English voice of a young man in his early twenties, crisp modern pan-Indian accent clear to global listeners, energetic but never shrill, attentive and resourceful, neat short sentences with a spring in each.
assets.text: Done! Your list is sorted. Sabzi first, then the chemist, then the post office on the way home. I've marked the busy hours in red so you can skip the queues. Anything else? I'm on it.

assets.voice_description: Soft, airy, dreamy Indian English female voice, gentle pan-Indian accent clear to global listeners, light breathy texture, slow floating cadence, reassuring like a loving storyteller at bedtime, full of quiet wonder.
assets.text: Close your eyes for a second and picture it: a little café with blue shutters, chai on the stove, rain on the window. That's your idea. Let's sketch it together, one cloud at a time, and see where it drifts.

assets.voice_description: Mature, measured Indian English voice of a woman in her late fifties, refined pan-Indian accent clear to global listeners, low and resonant, precise and thoughtful, deliberate pauses, the calm authority of a respected professor who chooses every word.
assets.text: Before we decide, consider this. Two of your sources agree, and one does not. The one that disagrees is the most recent. That is worth a closer look. I have laid out all three, so you can judge for yourself.

assets.voice_description: Calm, steady, warm Indian English male voice in his forties, mid-low pitch, pan-Indian accent clear to global listeners, even dependable rhythm, soft-spoken and kind, someone you trust to handle things while you sleep.
assets.text: Everything's in order. The backup finished at two, your reminders are set for the morning, and the electricity bill is paid. Nothing needs you tonight. If anything changes, I'll tell you first thing.
